messages.subject: RMR 3.1.0 equijoin in local mode
parts:
Hi 

I am trying following code in RMR 3.1.0 using local mode, it gives error when number of columns on left side and right side input are different. But it works in RMR version 3.1.1. I am having similar kind of code in my test cases. Is there anyway (without upgrading RMR) to run this code.  

library(rmr2)
rmr.options(backend = "local")

a = head(mtcars) # 11 columns 
b = head(data.frame(mpg= mtcars$mpg , cyl = mtcars$cyl, gear = mtcars$gear, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)) # 3 columns

leftMapper = function(k,v){keyval(v$cyl, v)} 
rightMapper = function(k,v){keyval(v$gear, v)} 

d = equijoin(
    left.input = to.dfs(a),
    right.input = to.dfs(b),
    map.left = leftMapper,
    map.right = rightMapper
    )

Error in names(y) = names(template) : 
  'names' attribute [11] must be the same length as the vector [3]

Thanks
Abhishek
